title: Associate Vice President
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Recommends the nature and scope of present and future product lines by reviewing product specifications and requirements; appraising new product ideas and/or product or packaging changes. Brings new products/solutions to market by analyzing proposed product requirements and product development programs; preparing return-on-investment analyses; establishing time schedules with engineering teams.  

* Achieves goals through the work of others
* Management responsibilities include performance appraisals, pay reviews, training and development
* Job focus is on managing others and applying operational or strategic management skills

  

* Manages professional employees and/or supervisors
* Is accountable for the performance and results of a team within own discipline
* Adapts departmental plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges
* Decisions are guided by policies, procedures and business plan; receives guidance from manager
* Provides technical guidance to employees, colleagues and/or customers

Functional Knowledge:  

* Requires understanding and application of procedures and concepts within own discipline and basic knowledge of other disciplines

Leadership:  

* Manages a generally homogeneous team; adapts plans and priorities to meet service and/or operational challenges

Problem Solving:  

* Identifies and resolves technical, operational and organizational problems

Impact:  

* Impacts the level of service and the team’s ability to meet quality, volume, and timeliness objectives
* Guided by policies, resource requirements, budgets and the business plan

Interpersonal Skills:  

* Guides, influences and persuades others either internally in other areas or externally with customers or agencies

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

title: Associate AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI
description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Overview**

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work.We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Position Overview:**

Boeing AI India team has an immediate opening for an **Associate AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI** to join their team in **Bengaluru, KA**. The selected individual will work in a team that innovates, develops & implements next generation AI/ML and engineering data analytics for aerospace applications. He/She/They will participate in projects to develop analytics solutions that helps improve aircraft performance, increase the operational efficiency of aircraft fleet operators, improve/optimize the productivity of Boeing engineering, operations & manufacturing and simulate aircraft lifecycle scenarios for potential customers. In addition, the candidate will support senior members of the team in developing future vision and direction of Boeing’s technology development in the field of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, image/video processing, NLP, GenAI, data analytics and their application to diverse areas relevant to Boeing.

Position Responsibilities :

* Development of innovative, machine land analysis to provide actionable information that improves aircraft and fleet efficiency and performance and helps increase productivity of Boeing engineers.
* Applying approaches such as novel statistical and probabilistic methods, machine learning multivariate analysis, predictive analytics and deep learning techniques to diverse areas such as airplane health management, manufacturing, automation, supply chain and more in order to add value to Boeing products.
* Help in the adoption of new tools and technology, perform Proof-of-concepts and help engagements implement & take over.
* Mentor & guide junior data scientists on their technical work and growth aspirations.
* Working closely & collaboratively with an international team comprising software development and research engineers. Develop and maintaining relationships / partnerships with customers, stakeholders, peers, and partners to develop collaborative plans and execute on projects.
* Help in the adoption of new tools and technology, perform Proof-of-concepts and help engagements implement & take over.
* Documenting results of research and development projects and provide inputs for periodic updates to in the form of progress reports, project summaries, and other related documents. Tracking and evaluating performance to ensure product and process conformance to project plans and project requirements.

**Employers will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.**

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement.
* 4+ years of Expertise in AI software development, data analytics and experience in building/deploying GenAI/LLM powered solutions.
* Hands-on experience with end-to-end ML lifecycle: data pipelines, training, deployment, monitoring, and optimization.
* Excellent presentation & communication skills: Demonstrate strong written, oral, presentation and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong research background in innovating & developing technologies & solutions thru data science & analytics.

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

* Bachelor degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement.
* Track record in performing research & development of highly innovative AI-driven solutions for difficult problems.
* Expertise in building and productizing Machine Learning/Deep Learning models.
* Hands on coding and implementation, deep understanding of machine learning, Gen AI concepts.
* Design, develop, and iterate on scalable AI/ML solutions, including a focus on Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic, information retrieval systems, and advanced ML paradigms.
* Apply proficiency in Python / R studio to deliver clean, efficient, and production-ready code.
* Drive the MLOps lifecycle by establishing and maintaining robust pipelines.
* Experience with containerization, model deployment, data management, and monitoring.
* Guide teams in applying Data Science and Data Modelling techniques to drive innovation, efficiency, and automation.
* Ensure timely deployment of models in a production environment.
* ML experience with synthetic data generation / domain adaptation / self-supervised learning.
* Solid software engineering practices: unit/integration testing, CI/CD, version control, and traceability to requirements.
* Demonstrated capability to apply advanced visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI.
* Be a self-starter who is not afraid to pro-actively seek information and direction to successfully complete the statement of work.
* Be self-motivated and able to work independently with a positive attitude and highest ethics.
* Must be willing to work flexible hours (early or late as needed) to interface with Boeing personnel around the world.

Typical Education & Experience:

Education/experience typically acquired through advanced education (e.g. Masters) and typically 5+ years' related work experience with Bachelor’s degree /4+ years’ related work experience with Master’s degree.

Relocation:

This position does offer relocation based on candidate eligibility within INDIA.

  
  

Applications for this position will be accepted until **Oct. 08, 2026**

  
  

**Export Control Requirements:**

This is not an Export Control position.

**Education**

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Required

**Relocation**

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

**Visa Sponsorship**

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

**Shift**

Shift 1 - Morning (India)

  
  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not accept unlawful discrimination in our recruitment or employment practices on any grounds including but not limited to; race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or other characteristics covered by applicable law.

We have teams in more than 65 countries, and each person plays a role in helping us become one of the world’s most innovative, diverse and inclusive companies. We are proud members of the Valuable 500 and welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. Applicants are encouraged to share with our recruitment team any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Accommodations may include but are not limited to: conducting interviews in accessible locations that accommodate mobility needs, encouraging candidates to bring and use any existing assistive technology such as screen readers and offering flexible interview formats such as virtual or phone interviews.

  

**Your Benefits**
-----------------

No matter where you are in life, our benefits help prepare you for the present and the future.

* Competitive base pay and incentive programs.
* Industry-leading tuition assistance program pays your institution directly.
* Resources and opportunities to grow your career.
* Up to $10,000 match when you support your favorite nonprofit organizations.

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
**About Valeo Health**  
Valeo Health is building a technology-driven healthcare ecosystem that makes diagnostic testing, preventive healthcare and other healthcare services more accessible and convenient for customers. As we scale, our Customer Support team is evolving beyond traditional support. We are looking for people who can not only solve customer queries but also understand why problems are happening, work with data, coordinate across teams and improve the way we operate.

**The Role**  
We are looking for a Customer Success Associate who is comfortable wearing multiple hats across Customer Support, Operations, Data and Process Improvement. You will help customers, resolve operational issues, coordinate across internal and external stakeholders, and identify opportunities to make our processes faster, simpler and more scalable. This is a great role for someone who thinks: “There has to be a better way to do this.”

**What You'll Do**  
**Customer Support:**  
-Handle customer queries across chat, calls, WhatsApp and other support channels. -Understand customer requirements and provide accurate, empathetic and timely resolutions.  
-Manage escalations, complaints, cancellations, reschedules, refunds and service-related issues.  
**-**Take ownership of customer issues until closure rather than simply passing them to another team.

**Operations & Coordination:**  
-Coordinate with internal teams, doctors, nurses, labs and other healthcare partners to resolve customer/order issues.  
-Monitor orders and identify delays, pending actions, failed fulfilments and operational gaps.  
-Ensure customers receive timely updates and resolutions. Support new services, processes and operational launches.

**Data & Reporting:**  
-Work with basic operational/customer data to identify trends, gaps and recurring issues.  
-Use Excel/Google Sheets for tracking, analysis and reporting.  
-Identify patterns behind customer complaints, cancellations, delays and other operational issues.  
-Convert data into actionable insights for the team.

**Process Improvement:**  
-Identify repetitive and mundane tasks that can be simplified, standardised or automated.  
-Suggest improvements to SOPs, workflows and internal processes.  
-Work with Product, Operations and other teams to improve the customer journey.  
-Help reduce manual effort and improve team productivity.  
-Support automation and AI-led initiatives where relevant.

**Problem Solving & Ownership:**  
-Investigate the root cause of recurring issues instead of only solving individual cases. -Work independently on ambiguous problems and drive them towards closure.  
-Be comfortable moving between customer-facing work, operational tasks and analytical/problem-solving work.

**What We're Looking**  
-For 1–3 years of experience in Customer Support, Customer Experience, Operations, HealthTech, Healthcare, Logistics or a similar fast-paced environment.  
-Strong written and verbal communication skills.  
-Good problem-solving and analytical ability.  
-Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and basic data analysis.  
-Strong ownership and follow-up skills.  
-Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and stakeholders.  
-Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment.  
-Ability to prioritise multiple tasks without losing attention to detail.  
-Customer-first mindset with strong operational thinking.

**Good to Have**  
These are not mandatory, but will be a strong advantage:  
-Experience with AI tools, automation or workflow optimisation.  
-Experience identifying and reducing repetitive/manual work.  
-Exposure to CRM/helpdesk platforms, dashboards, workflow tools or automation platforms.  
-Healthcare/HealthTech experience.  
-Basic understanding of metrics, reporting and operational KPIs.  
-Ability to independently build simple trackers, reports or process improvements.

**What Success Looks Like**  
In this role, success isn't just about how many customer queries you close. We want someone who can:  
-Resolve customers' problems effectively.  
-Identify recurring issues and their root causes.  
-Use data to understand what's happening.  
-Reduce unnecessary manual work. Improve processes and customer experience.  
-Take ownership without waiting for instructions at every step.  
-Help the team become faster, smarter and more scalable.

**Why Valeo?**  
You will get the opportunity to work at the intersection of Customer Experience, Healthcare, Operations, Data and Technology.

As Valeo grows, this role can evolve significantly for someone who demonstrates strong ownership, analytical thinking and the ability to improve how we operate.

If you're someone who doesn't just solve the problem but asks, “Why are we solving this manually in the first place?” — we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
